attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1/node2/node3 (Alpine Linux) with node1 as initial primary and node2/node3 as async standbys, using a generated replicator role for basebackup/streaming auth. Demonstrated failover by stopping node1, promoting node2 to writable primary (pg_ctl promote), confirmed zero committed-data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, and rebuilt the recovered node1 as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup. Final steady state: node2 = writable primary, node1 & node3 = streaming standbys of node2. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, then node3, then node2 last since it was primary), proving changed boot_id on each and confirming full replication/cluster health and data integrity after each restart.
